title: Cosy Cafe 0.14.2
author: Cosy Creator
font_credit: MiSans (c) 2020-2021 Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
_coverage_note: 32,639 player-visible literals, 100% translated. No <b> tags anywhere in the game, so MiSans-Bold.ttf ships unused.
_why_not_tl_blocks: See docs/approach.md. This game ships no game/tl/<lang>/ templates, and tools/install.py can only place a translation-patch game/tl/<lang>/ tree plus a shim. Cosy Cafe instead replaces 27 of its own .rpy files wholesale, so it is installed with tools/install.ps1 rather than tools/install.py.
